# Card tokenization request validation (draft)

owner: matt s. (product), last touched by me on the 3rd, sorry it's rough

What the request looks like: top level has `card`, `metadata`, `token_policy`. card.billing.address is nested under card.

## PAN
- 13 to 19 digits, must pass luhn
- probably strip spaces and dashes before checking? not sure about dashes, ask risk
- never log the PAN, even masked in debug output

## Expiry
- MM/YY or MM/YYYY
- can't be in the past
- max ~10 years out? I think risk said 10, maybe 7

## CVV
- cvv is fine in the auth request body
- must NOT show up in anything we store (token vault, audit table, the request log)
- which fields count as "stored" is TBD, see the data map

## Nesting
- keep it sane, something like max depth 5 or 6. not sure which

## Metadata
- flat-ish string to string map
- max 50 keys? (eng said 64 in the old spec)

## token_policy
- list of allowed scopes
- unknown scope = reject? or ignore? TBD

## Unicode / nulls
- cardholder names can be unicode, normalize to NFC
- emoji in names: probably reject, idk
- null vs missing vs empty string: not decided. treat empty as missing?

old validator still used by the gateway adapter, don't break its signature
